_comment: Example markers file. Copy it next to a recording, then run:
npm run transcribe:dry -- --markers recordings/2026-05-08.markers.json
meeting.date     YYYY-MM-DD. One meeting per date; re-running reuses it.
meeting.format   zoom | in-person | hybrid
recording        resolved against the working directory, then against
this file's own folder. Never uploaded - only the clips are.
Each marker:
at          "HH:MM:SS.mmm", "MM:SS", or a number of seconds.
Must be strictly increasing. A clip runs from one marker to
the next, whatever kind the next one is.
recipient   a name or a known spelling variant, matched case-insensitively.
null means "to be confirmed" and publishes with no recipient.
A name that matches nobody is an error outside --dry-run.
giver       same matching. null or omitted means "not recorded".
addendum    true attaches a further segment to that recipient's earlier
word in this same file, instead of creating a new word.
guest       true makes this a guest word: emailed once, then deleted.
Never published to members. Pair it with guestEmail.
guestEmail  the guest's address, or null/absent to add it in review.
end         true marks where the last word stops. Must be the final
marker and carries nothing else. Omit it to run to the end
of the recording.
note        free text for whoever reviews it. Not published.
Keys starting with _ are ignored.

markers.note: Operator tapped late - drag the start back about 5s in review.
Emailed once on approval, then deleted.
Name unclear on the recording - confirm in review.
